description: Category 1 (numerical) questions with integer answers, authored from the challenge sample questions and reference images in questions/home_building_2/questions.pdf. Objects are restricted to salient, visually verifiable furniture and decor so a human can confirm every answer from the scene. Each question carries a machine-readable spec that scripts/eval/verify_benchmark2.py re-evaluates against the iref_vla object bounding boxes.
notes: Q01 is the official Category 1 sample question from questions/home_building_2/questions.pdf; its answer (2) is the answer printed in the PDF.
difficulty: easy = single salient object class; medium = one relation or a room restriction; hard = two chained relations.

home_building_2 is a whole apartment split into five iref regions: 4 = open-plan living, dining and kitchen, 5 = bedroom with the dressing table, 6 = bathroom, 7 = bedroom with the TV, 2 = the gates outside. Room-scoped questions restrict the selector to the matching region.
The two bedrooms are never named directly: each is identified by its furniture (the dressing table, the TV), matching the phrasing style of the sample questions.
Q01 and Q02 are deliberately paired: two of the four pillows on the sofa are red.
Dishes are not used as a count target: the stack on the dining table is annotated twice at identical coordinates, so the number would not match what a human counts.

This scene has no bag recording yet (bags/scenes.yaml skips it), so the iref metadata was copied from /home/ubuntu/myspace/SORT3D/data/IRef-VLA/Unity/home_building_2 into bags/home_building_2/iref_vla_metadata for verification.
object_ids lists supporting iref_vla scene-graph ids for auditing; SAM3 should use target_objects.

questions.question: How many red pillows are on the sofa?
questions.evidence: Of the four loose pillows on sofa 134, the two in the middle (85, 213) are red; the others are a purple one and a patterned brown one.

questions.question: How many pillows are on the sofa in total?
questions.evidence: Four loose pillows lie along sofa 134: purple 71, red 85 and 213, and patterned 94. The four upright back cushions are annotated separately as 'sofa cushion'.

questions.question: How many chairs are around the dining table?
questions.evidence: Four dining chairs (65, 125, 156, 177) stand around dining table 171, two on each side.

questions.question: How many speakers are on the TV cabinet?
questions.evidence: Four speakers stand on TV cabinet 135: tall towers 84 and 122, cube speaker 91 and centre speaker 108. The other items on the cabinet are a DVD player, a potted plant and a sculpture.

questions.question: How many wine glasses are on the table with the kettle on it?
questions.evidence: Coffee table 70 holds kettle 89 and two wine glasses (81, 93) either side of the wine bottle; the other two wine glasses are on the kitchen island.

questions.question: How many wine bottles are standing on the kitchen island?
questions.evidence: Three bottles (75, 97, 118) stand upright on top of kitchen island 139; the remaining bottles lie on their sides in the wine rack built into the island.

questions.question: How many kettles are in the apartment?
questions.evidence: Two matching teal kettles: 89 on the coffee table and 142 on the dining table.

questions.question: How many pillows are on the bed in the bedroom with the dressing table?
questions.evidence: Bed 25 in the bedroom with dressing table 19 carries four pillows (23, 24, 26, 27), two stacked pairs.

questions.question: How many pillows are on the bed in the bedroom with the TV?
questions.evidence: Bed 66 in the bedroom facing TV 55 has two pillows (62, 63) side by side.

questions.question: How many nightstands are in the apartment?
questions.evidence: Four nightstands, a pair flanking each of the two beds: 20 and 21 in the first bedroom, 53 and 54 in the second.
